falseSynonyms.zh: because of 後接名詞，不是完整從句 because 後接完整子句；because of 後接名詞、代名詞或名詞片語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Because it rained, we stayed inside. Because of the rain, we stayed inside.

falseSynonyms.zh: due to 通常後接名詞片語 due to 本身不是 because 的完全句法替代；若後接完整子句，通常要用 due to the fact that。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The delay was due to heavy traffic; we were late because traffic was heavy.

falseSynonyms.zh: owing to 通常後接名詞片語 owing to + noun；若要接完整子句，可用 owing to the fact that。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The match was cancelled owing to rain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 因此是結果，不是原因從句連接詞 therefore 引出結果；because 引出原因，邏輯方向相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It was raining; therefore, we stayed inside. We stayed inside because it was raining.

falseSynonyms.zh: 所以引出結果，不是原因 so 通常把原因放前、結果放後；because 則引出原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It was late, so we left. We left because it was late.

falseSynonyms.zh: 雖然表示讓步，不是因果 although 表示『儘管』；不能代替 because。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Although it was raining, we went out.

falseSynonyms.zh: 如果表示條件，不是原因 if 引出條件；because 引出已成立的原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON If it rains, we will stay inside.

falseSynonyms.zh: while 通常表示同時或對比 while 可表示時間或對比；一般不能當作 because 的直接替代。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON While I understand your point, I disagree.
